mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `role_permission` (role_id, permission_id) VALUES
(#{roleId}, #{permissionId})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role_id = VALUES(role_id)
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.parent_id, p.permission_name, p.permission_code, p.type, p.path, p.component, p.status, p.sort, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM `role_permission` rp INNER JOIN `permission` p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.sort ASC, p.id ASC
